title: Complementarity after one XOR step
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ variables, and let $p,q$ be pairs of Boolean circuit trees on those variables. If the two circuits in each pair evaluate under $x$ to complementary values, then the two circuits in the pair produced by one XOR step also evaluate under $x$ to complementary values.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
$p,q$ are pairs of circuit trees on $n$ variables
The second circuit in $p$ evaluates under $x$ to the negation of its first circuit
